baseline.scope: Reproduce the implemented application, preserve its unknowns and release gates; not a claim of a complete current-patch Albion companion.
baseline.requiredCheckout: Use the commit containing this handbook or a later reviewed descendant. The feature baseline predates the handoff and its restoration of the omitted unit-test directory.

instructions: Regenerate from repository root with node scripts/rebuild-inventory.mjs; --check verifies drift. Textual boundary references are navigation aids, not an authorization audit.

scripts.build: prisma generate && next build && node scripts/prepare-standalone.mjs

definitions.name: User
definitions.definition:
model User {
 marketWatchItems MarketWatchItem[]
 timers Timer[]
  id String @id @default(cuid())
  name String?
  email String? @unique
  emailVerified DateTime?
  image String?
  role String @default("USER")
  region String @default("europe")
  characterName String?
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt
  compositions Composition[]
  ownedGroups Group[]
  memberships GroupMember[]
  builds Build[]
  accounts Account[]
  sessions Session[]
  groupRequests GroupMembershipRequest[]
  groupRsvps EventRSVP[]

  authoredAnnouncements GroupAnnouncement[]
  authoredGroupEvents GroupEvent[]
  authoredGroupBuilds GroupBuild[]
  issuedGroupInvites GroupInvitation[]

  savedScenarios SavedScenario[]

  buildFavorites BuildFavorite[]
  compositionFavorites CompositionFavorite[]
  buildVotes BuildVote[]
  comments ContentComment[]
  reports ContentReport[] @relation("ReportAuthor")
  reviewedReports ContentReport[] @relation("ReportReviewer")
  moderationLogs ModerationLog[]

}

definitions.name: Account
definitions.definition:
model Account {
  id String @id @default(cuid())
  userId String
  type String
  provider String
  providerAccountId String
  refresh_token String? @db.Text
  access_token String? @db.Text
  expires_at Int?
  token_type String?
  scope String?
  id_token String? @db.Text
  session_state String?
  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  @@unique([provider, providerAccountId])
  @@index([userId])
}

definitions.name: Session
definitions.definition:
model Session {
  id String @id @default(cuid())
  sessionToken String @unique
  userId String
  expires DateTime
  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  @@index([userId])
}

definitions.name: VerificationToken
BuildVisibility
Build
definitions.definition:
model Build {
  id String @id @default(cuid())
  authorId String
  author User @relation(fields: [authorId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  title String
  description String @db.Text
  contentType String
  region String
  visibility BuildVisibility @default(PRIVATE)
  playerCount Int @default(1)
  recommendedIP Int @default(0)
  strategy String @db.Text
  patchNotes String @db.Text
  version Int @default(1)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt
  equipment BuildEquipment[]
  versions BuildVersion[]
  @@index([visibility, updatedAt])
  @@index([authorId, updatedAt])
  groupSnapshots GroupBuild[]

 hiddenAt DateTime?
 comments ContentComment[]
 reports ContentReport[]
 favorites BuildFavorite[]
 votes BuildVote[]

}

definitions.name: BuildEquipment
definitions.definition:
model BuildEquipment {
  id String @id @default(cuid())
  buildId String
  build Build @relation(fields: [buildId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  slot String
  itemId String
  quality Int
  abilities String @db.Text
  alternatives String @db.Text
  @@unique([buildId, slot])
  abilitySelections Json @default("{}")
  alternativeItemIds String[] @default([])

}

definitions.name: BuildVersion
definitions.definition:
model BuildVersion {
  id String @id @default(cuid())
  buildId String
  build Build @relation(fields: [buildId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  version Int
  snapshot Json
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  @@unique([buildId, version])
}

definitions.name: GroupRole
ContentVisibility
Group
definitions.definition:
model Group {
 id String @id @default(cuid())
 name String
 slug String @unique
 description String @db.Text
 region String
 visibility String @default("PRIVATE")
 ownerId String
 owner User @relation(fields:[ownerId],references:[id],onDelete:Restrict)
 createdAt DateTime @default(now())
 updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt
 members GroupMember[]
 compositions Composition[]
 @@index([visibility,updatedAt])
 @@index([ownerId])
  invitations GroupInvitation[]
  requests GroupMembershipRequest[]
  announcements GroupAnnouncement[]
  events GroupEvent[]
  builds GroupBuild[]

}

definitions.name: GroupMember
definitions.definition:
model GroupMember {
 groupId String
 userId String
 role GroupRole @default(MEMBER)
 joinedAt DateTime @default(now())
 group Group @relation(fields:[groupId],references:[id],onDelete:Cascade)
 user User @relation(fields:[userId],references:[id],onDelete:Cascade)
 @@id([groupId,userId])
 @@index([userId])
}

definitions.name: Composition
definitions.definition:
model Composition {
 id String @id @default(cuid())
 authorId String
 author User @relation(fields:[authorId],references:[id],onDelete:Cascade)
 groupId String?
 group Group? @relation(fields:[groupId],references:[id],onDelete:Cascade)
 title String
 description String @db.Text
 region String
 contentType String
 visibility ContentVisibility @default(PRIVATE)
 slots Json
 notes String @db.Text
 version Int @default(1)
 createdAt DateTime @default(now())
 updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt
 versions CompositionVersion[]
 @@index([authorId,updatedAt])
 @@index([visibility,updatedAt])
 @@index([groupId,updatedAt])
  events GroupEvent[]

 hiddenAt DateTime?
 comments ContentComment[]
 reports ContentReport[]
 favorites CompositionFavorite[]

}

definitions.name: CompositionVersion
definitions.definition:
model CompositionVersion {
 id String @id @default(cuid())
 compositionId String
 composition Composition @relation(fields:[compositionId],references:[id],onDelete:Cascade)
 version Int
 snapshot Json
 createdAt DateTime @default(now())
 @@unique([compositionId,version])
}

definitions.name: GroupInvitation
definitions.definition:
model GroupInvitation {
 id String @id @default(cuid())
 groupId String
 group Group @relation(fields:[groupId],references:[id],onDelete:Cascade)
 tokenHash String @unique
 createdById String?
 createdBy User? @relation(fields:[createdById],references:[id],onDelete:SetNull)
 expiresAt DateTime
 acceptedAt DateTime?
 revokedAt DateTime?
 createdAt DateTime @default(now())
 @@index([groupId,createdAt])
}

definitions.name: GroupMembershipRequest
definitions.definition:
model GroupMembershipRequest {
 groupId String
 userId String
 group Group @relation(fields:[groupId],references:[id],onDelete:Cascade)
 user User @relation(fields:[userId],references:[id],onDelete:Cascade)
 status String @default("PENDING")
 message String @db.Text
 updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt
 @@id([groupId,userId])
 @@index([groupId,status])
}

definitions.name: GroupAnnouncement
definitions.definition:
model GroupAnnouncement {
 id String @id @default(cuid())
 groupId String
 group Group @relation(fields:[groupId],references:[id],onDelete:Cascade)
 title String
 body String @db.Text
 authorId String?
 author User? @relation(fields:[authorId],references:[id],onDelete:SetNull)
 createdAt DateTime @default(now())
 @@index([groupId,createdAt])
}

definitions.name: GroupEvent
definitions.definition:
model GroupEvent {
 version Int @default(1)
 id String @id @default(cuid())
 groupId String
 group Group @relation(fields:[groupId],references:[id],onDelete:Cascade)
 title String
 description String @db.Text
 startsAt DateTime
 timezone String
 expectedParticipants Int
 voiceInfo String
 compositionId String?
 composition Composition? @relation(fields:[compositionId],references:[id],onDelete:SetNull)
 cancelled Boolean @default(false)
 authorId String?
 author User? @relation(fields:[authorId],references:[id],onDelete:SetNull)
 createdAt DateTime @default(now())
 rsvps EventRSVP[]
 @@index([groupId,startsAt])
}

definitions.name: EventRSVP
definitions.definition:
model EventRSVP {
 eventId String
 userId String
 event GroupEvent @relation(fields:[eventId],references:[id],onDelete:Cascade)
 user User @relation(fields:[userId],references:[id],onDelete:Cascade)
 status String
 role String
 updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt
 @@id([eventId,userId])
}

definitions.name: GroupBuild
definitions.definition:
model GroupBuild {
 id String @id @default(cuid())
 groupId String
 group Group @relation(fields:[groupId],references:[id],onDelete:Cascade)
 title String
 snapshot Json
 sourceBuildId String?
 sourceBuild Build? @relation(fields:[sourceBuildId],references:[id],onDelete:SetNull)
 authorId String?
 author User? @relation(fields:[authorId],references:[id],onDelete:SetNull)
 createdAt DateTime @default(now())
 @@index([groupId,createdAt])
}

definitions.name: SavedScenario
definitions.definition:
model SavedScenario {
 id String @id @default(cuid())
 authorId String
 author User @relation(fields:[authorId],references:[id],onDelete:Cascade)
 title String
 kind String
 configuration Json
 createdAt DateTime @default(now())
 updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt
 @@index([authorId,updatedAt])
}

definitions.name: CatalogRelease
definitions.definition:
model CatalogRelease {
 id String @id @default(cuid())
 version String @unique
 sourceUrl String
 rightsReference String
 checksum String
 importedAt DateTime @default(now())
 itemCount Int
 items ItemMetadata[]
}

definitions.name: ItemMetadata
definitions.definition:
model ItemMetadata {
 id String @id
 name String
 slot String
 tier Int
 enchantment Int
 itemPower Int?
 abilities Json
 recipe Json?
 releaseId String
 release CatalogRelease @relation(fields:[releaseId],references:[id],onDelete:Restrict)
 active Boolean @default(true)
 @@index([active,slot,tier])
 @@index([name])
}

definitions.name: BuildFavorite
definitions.definition:
model BuildFavorite {
 userId String
 buildId String
 user User @relation(fields:[userId],references:[id],onDelete:Cascade)
 build Build @relation(fields:[buildId],references:[id],onDelete:Cascade)
 createdAt DateTime @default(now())
 @@id([userId,buildId])
 @@index([buildId])
}

definitions.name: CompositionFavorite
definitions.definition:
model CompositionFavorite {
 userId String
 compositionId String
 user User @relation(fields:[userId],references:[id],onDelete:Cascade)
 composition Composition @relation(fields:[compositionId],references:[id],onDelete:Cascade)
 createdAt DateTime @default(now())
 @@id([userId,compositionId])
 @@index([compositionId])
}

definitions.name: BuildVote
definitions.definition:
model BuildVote {
 userId String
 buildId String
 user User @relation(fields:[userId],references:[id],onDelete:Cascade)
 build Build @relation(fields:[buildId],references:[id],onDelete:Cascade)
 createdAt DateTime @default(now())
 @@id([userId,buildId])
 @@index([buildId])
}

definitions.name: ContentComment
definitions.definition:
model ContentComment {
 id String @id @default(cuid())
 authorId String
 author User @relation(fields:[authorId],references:[id],onDelete:Cascade)
 buildId String?
 build Build? @relation(fields:[buildId],references:[id],onDelete:Cascade)
 compositionId String?
 composition Composition? @relation(fields:[compositionId],references:[id],onDelete:Cascade)
 body String @db.Text
 version Int @default(1)
 hiddenAt DateTime?
 deletedAt DateTime?
 createdAt DateTime @default(now())
 updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt
 revisions CommentRevision[]
 reports ContentReport[]
 @@index([buildId,createdAt])
 @@index([compositionId,createdAt])
 @@index([authorId])
}

definitions.name: CommentRevision
definitions.definition:
model CommentRevision {
 id String @id @default(cuid())
 commentId String
 comment ContentComment @relation(fields:[commentId],references:[id],onDelete:Cascade)
 version Int
 body String @db.Text
 createdAt DateTime @default(now())
 @@unique([commentId,version])
}

definitions.name: ContentReport
definitions.definition:
model ContentReport {
 version Int @default(1)
 id String @id @default(cuid())
 authorId String?
 author User? @relation("ReportAuthor",fields:[authorId],references:[id],onDelete:SetNull)
 buildId String?
 build Build? @relation(fields:[buildId],references:[id],onDelete:Cascade)
 compositionId String?
 composition Composition? @relation(fields:[compositionId],references:[id],onDelete:Cascade)
 commentId String?
 comment ContentComment? @relation(fields:[commentId],references:[id],onDelete:Cascade)
 reason String @db.Text
 status String @default("OPEN")
 reviewerId String?
 reviewer User? @relation("ReportReviewer",fields:[reviewerId],references:[id],onDelete:SetNull)
 reviewNote String @default("") @db.Text
 createdAt DateTime @default(now())
 reviewedAt DateTime?
 @@index([status,createdAt])
}

definitions.name: ModerationLog
definitions.definition:
model ModerationLog {
 id String @id @default(cuid())
 actorId String?
 actor User? @relation(fields:[actorId],references:[id],onDelete:SetNull)
 targetType String
 targetId String
 action String
 reason String @db.Text
 createdAt DateTime @default(now())
 @@index([createdAt])
}

definitions.name: Timer
definitions.definition:
model Timer {
 id String @id @default(cuid())
 userId String
 user User @relation(fields:[userId],references:[id],onDelete:Cascade)
 title String
 category String
 status String @default("RUNNING")
 durationMs Int
 dueAt DateTime?
 remainingMs Int?
 version Int @default(1)
 createdAt DateTime @default(now())
 updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt
 @@index([userId,updatedAt])
}

definitions.name: MarketWatchItem
definitions.definition:
model MarketWatchItem {
 id String @id @default(cuid())
 userId String
 user User @relation(fields:[userId],references:[id],onDelete:Cascade)
 region String
 itemId String
 quality Int @default(1)
 createdAt DateTime @default(now())
 @@unique([userId,region,itemId,quality])
}
